purpose: a superseded dry-run of the P6 verifier, retained rather than overwritten so the pre-amendment threshold attestation survives
why_it_matters: this run re-derived q05/q95/S90 for all five markets from the raw sources and matched them bit-exactly, before the P5 freeze was amended with the float32 representation disclosure; it is therefore the independent record that the amendment added a disclosure without changing a single threshold value
pre_amendment_threshold_attestation: q05/q95/S90 re-derived from TRAIN source values only and match bit-exactly under the benchmark's float32 window representation (GANSU_DA:q05=40.4355,q95=600.0000,S90=559.7470; SHANDONG_DA:q05=-80.0000,q95=633.8921,S90=822.7760; SHAANXI_DA:q05=40.0000,q95=550.0000,S90=857.8797; NINGXIA_DA:q05=40.0000,q95=384.0000,S90=349.4776; QINGHAI_DA:q05=80.0000,q95=650.0000,S90=570.0000); the same numbers read as float64 from source differ by at most 5.86e-05 absolute (the window-dtype cast); harm units declared; problems=[]
retained_outside_the_frozen_evidence_tre: the evidence tree is audited by the verifier itself and this file is the verifier's own report, not a stage artifact
